enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Sigh. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Remain still. Breathe slowly.

Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush back. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out cereal box. Close cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse bowl. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close closet. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Pick up keys. Pick up phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for time. Look at watch. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Hold bag on lap. Look out window. Adjust seat. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet colleague with 'Good morning'. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Open calendar. Attend morning meeting. Take notes. Discuss program plans. Make phone calls to community partners. Write reports. Update database. Print documents. Attend lunch meeting. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Review budget. Coordinate with volunteers. Send emails. Organize files. Attend afternoon meeting. Update social media. Prepare materials for next day. Shut down computer. Pack bag. Leave office.

Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Rest head. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner with fork. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch news. Change channel. Watch sitcom. Laugh. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust pillow. Lie back on sofa. Watch more TV. Change channel. Watch movie. Pause TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Resume TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from sofa. Walk to closet. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Close closet. Plug vacuum into outlet. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Move coffee table. Vacuum under table. Vacuum rug. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wrap cord. Put vacuum back in closet. Pick up items from floor. Place items in basket. Dust coffee table with cloth. Arrange pillows on sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and using computer and phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open browser. Check social media. Type email. Send email. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Close computer. Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Send text messages. Read news. Play game. Put down phone. Stand up. Stretch. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush back. Turn off tap. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off light. Walk out.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Sigh. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Remain still. Breathe slowly.
